what: MOXIR 2026-10-17 v5 (show day): the 50 scenes re-authored for the WASHES and the 18 BEAMS, lasers at 0 (owner 08:2x: lasers later, when ready). Beam colours only from the B380F wheel slots SEEN (fixtureTypes.js B380F_SLOTS_SEEN; blue banned by the eye rule); heads use the whole headMotion.js vocabulary (fan, sweep, cross, circle, figure8, nod, wave x all/alternate/ripple/left-right), periods on the 132 bpm bar (1.82 s); fx.js modes on washes and beams. Kept from v3/v4: ids, acts, cue timing, energy, the floor strips, the outside, the v4 laser design under laser_parked.
source: designed by the scenes-50 designer agent (Opus) of chat aa61368c, 2026-10-15; re-coloured v2 by the recolour agent (Opus, headless) 2026-10-15 03:15; v3 (Palette 3) by the recolour-3 agent (Opus, headless, lead f41c885f) 2026-10-15 06:0x; generator ~/work/agent-reports-2026-10-15/moxir-50/scenes-tools/scenes50.py + palette.py (v2 copies in scenes-tools/v2/); colours pixel-sampled by palette_sample.py (palette_samples.json); outside parts by outside_rule.py; rig scripts/place/rigs/moxir-v2-10-2026-10-15.json; motion vocabulary serverXR/src/lighting/fx.js · lasers v4 2026-10-17: the whole field (zone opened by the officer 07:1x), wide fans/sweeps/arches/curtains, cycles ≥ 14.5 s for the 4.36 s keyframes · v5 2026-10-17 08:xx by dob-74 (Fable), scratchpad scenes_v5.py; base = this file at v3-palette3+lasers-v4
licence: di.iiii project data (the owner's); MOXIR teaser frames used as reference only, never published

rules.floor: line L + line R held still, never red, desaturated (HSV S <= 0.6), focus shift <= 0.2 D; level so luminance x level ~ 0.06: act 1 ice 0.07; act 2 mint 0.07; act 3 rose-copper 0.14; act 4 petrol 0.08; act 5 lavender 0.15; act 5 ends (scenes 48-50) ice 0.07; blue-wave: cut down lavender 0.3; luminance x level >= v1 floor (deep ember 0.25) = 0.0221
rules.flash: worst 1 s per lamp <= 3 flashes (WCAG 2.x flash definition, measured on fx.js)

eye_v3.no_saturated_blue_or_violet_lamps: linear B share >= 0.8 banned on every lamp (lasers excepted)
eye_v3.method: palette.py eye(); thresholds are taste, unvalidated

rules.beam_colours: B380F_SLOTS_SEEN only (open, red, green, yellow, magenta, amber, lime, orange, red-orange, warm white, light blue); blue banned (eye rule)
rules.lasers: laser part absent from every scene (level 0) until the owner signs the lasers off; design kept in laser_parked

scenes_with_red_inside_per_act.rule: saturated red (WCAG 2.2 R share >= 0.8, linear) or hue within 15 deg of red at S >= 0.6, any inside part; the owner-set entrance is outside and not counted

scenes.title: The road in
scenes.intent: Doors. Outside the road and the entrance; inside the plane stands as six ice columns in a still fan, breathing; the truss low steel.
scenes.notes: outside = the owner's rule (road toxic green, entrance dark amber, 03:5x), unchanged

scenes.title: First light
scenes.intent: The plane alone: six open-white columns lean toward the DJ one after another, a ripple of light blue; nothing else.
scenes.notes: the owner's 'blackout + one beam': a part is 6 beams, the closest the data can say

laser_parked.why: first light: one searchlight each side sweeps the whole width of the field along the roof line, 96 s

scenes.title: Slow sweep
scenes.intent: The plane sweeps once every eight bars, left and right mirrored like a slow gate; cold white up on the truss.

scenes.title: Steel breath
scenes.intent: Steel blue rays breathe in a slow wave toward the DJ; the plane in light blue nods in a ripple; petrol behind the DJ.

scenes.title: The DJ alone
scenes.intent: The DJ in warm white, the plane in warm white too, leaning slowly as one; the truss holds him; the floor steel.
scenes.notes: warm white = the tungsten key of the stage (LEE 204 Full CTO), the one warm thing of act 1

scenes.title: Ice rays
scenes.intent: The four rays rise in ice, a wave rolling toward the DJ; the walls wake as light blue columns in a fan, still.

scenes.title: The wall wakes
scenes.intent: All eighteen beams in light blue: a sweep walks down the walls to the DJ in a ripple while the plane crosses like scissors; the truss petrol up.

scenes.title: Cold columns
scenes.intent: The walls in open white, twelve straight columns in the haze, crossing gently in alternate pairs; the plane dark; cold white chases down the rays.

laser_parked.why: two cold lines cross slowly like the columns, the whole width

scenes.title: Rust, low
scenes.intent: Rose-copper rays spark each on their own count; the plane in amber, a slow figure-eight; warm white on the cut down: the rust of the hall.
scenes.notes: the one warm moment of act 1, now without red: rose-copper (t5 #ad756c hue; rust returns warm light best, measured); sparkle only at 20 bpm

scenes.title: First net
scenes.intent: The first green: the plane in lime, a circle ripple; mint up on the truss, mint rays breathing; the hall turns toward the poster.
scenes.notes: the poster's green arrives: lasers diode green, lamps poster green (t1/t2 hue 126 deg)

laser_parked.why: the green net, 18 lines a cube, crossing and parting

scenes.title: Green chase
scenes.intent: The walls in lime chase down to the DJ, the sweep ripples along both walls; the plane green; the truss poster glow.

scenes.title: Run to the DJ
scenes.intent: The poster glow runs down both walls to the DJ on every half beat; all eighteen beams lime, the walls mirrored, the plane a fast nod.

scenes.title: Rays pulse
scenes.intent: Rays and truss pulse mint at half time; the plane in lime draws a wave; the walls stand in a wide green fan.

scenes.title: The cut
scenes.intent: The truss over the DJ in poster glow, blocks flipping; mint behind him; the plane and walls in lime cross as mirrored scissors.

scenes.title: Left, right
scenes.intent: The two walls answer each other in open white, bars left and right; the beams trace a mirrored figure-eight; the plane lime.

laser_parked.why: the outer cubes answer each other across the whole field (14.5 s, what the frames can show)

scenes.title: Glow comet
scenes.intent: One comet of poster glow leaves the truss and runs through the rays toward the entrance; the plane green, a slow ripple of lean.

scenes.title: Scissors
scenes.intent: The six plane beams in lime lean against each other like scissors; the walls in green sweep mirrored; the truss poster glow breathing.

laser_parked.why: scissors: wide fans open and close, mirrored

scenes.title: Green comb
scenes.intent: A comb: the plane in lime as a still fan, the walls pulsing green at half time in a chase; cold white truss up, mint top light.

laser_parked.why: the comb, 24 teeth, pulsing at half time

scenes.title: Ping-pong rays
scenes.intent: A petrol head bounces across the rays, left to right and back; the walls in lime sweep in a ripple down the hall; the plane open white.

scenes.title: Riser
scenes.intent: Before the drop: white walls and plane pulse on the beat, the beams circle faster and faster; mint rays; the truss turns lavender.
scenes.notes: lavender enters on the cut: the colour of the peak to come

laser_parked.why: the riser comb, 24 teeth

scenes.title: White cathedral
scenes.intent: The drop: all eighteen beams open white in a wide fan over lavender rays; the truss pumps cold white up and down; lavender behind the DJ.

laser_parked.why: the drop: a still white fan of 36 lines from each cube, the whole width under the roof — the cathedral floor of light

scenes.title: Strobe hit
scenes.intent: The whole hall strobes cold white for 6 s, the beams with it (under 3 flashes a second); the walls as a still fan.

scenes.title: Red room
scenes.intent: Red: all eighteen beams red, the rays ember pumping on the beat, the truss ember; a nod ripples across the plane; warm key on the DJ. The one red room.
scenes.notes: the owner's 'red room' (09-28 loop): red as an accent, 20 s; the floor stays rose-copper; pump = 3 flashes/s max (WCAG 2.3.1 red-flash limit met)

laser_parked.why: red fans pump, wide, mirrored (no green in this scene)

scenes.title: The storm
scenes.intent: The storm: open-white walls in bars across the hall, the beams in a fast mirrored figure-eight; petrol rays and petrol behind the DJ; the truss full cold white.

laser_parked.why: the storm: green fans chase across the six cubes

scenes.title: The matrix
scenes.intent: Rose-copper rays breathe under a lavender plane that circles slowly; the walls in amber as a still fan; the truss rose-copper up.

laser_parked.why: the matrix comb at its cap, 24 teeth, breathing 0.3–1

scenes.title: Pump white
scenes.intent: All eighteen beams and the truss hit on the beat in open white; the beams turn a mirrored bow-tie; the rays ice.

scenes.title: Radar
scenes.intent: A lavender radar line sweeps round the rays and the truss; the beams in light blue circle in a ripple, the walls sweep down the hall.

laser_parked.why: radar: one lavender line per cube sweeps the whole field, west → east chase

scenes.title: Blinders
scenes.intent: The blinder moment: the cut, the kicker, the key and the rays hit full ash on every beat; the beams warm white, a wide still fan.
scenes.notes: no blinder fixtures in the kit: the truss washes stand in; ash (the warm white) is closest to a tungsten blinder (taste)

scenes.title: Copper scissors
scenes.intent: Rose-copper walls and an amber plane flip on the half beat; the beams cross fast in mirrored scissors; the truss rose-copper.
scenes.notes: v2 id red-scissors: ember walls became rose-copper (the beams show the wheel's Pink)

scenes.title: Sparkle peak
scenes.intent: Lavender walls and an open-white plane sparkle, each on its own count; the plane draws a slow wave; the truss lavender up, cold white down.

laser_parked.why: sparkle peak: 24 lavender dots run round an arch on each flank, where the roof allows height, 96 s

scenes.title: Drop away
scenes.intent: Almost dark: the plane in deep sea, one slow lean; the floor petrol. The truss: only a deep-sea back light.

scenes.title: One beam back
scenes.intent: The plane returns in warm white, low, a lean travelling across it; warm white on the DJ; the truss finds him.

scenes.title: Blue wave
scenes.intent: A deep-sea wave rolls along the rays toward the DJ; the plane in magenta, the first rare colour, in a slow circle; the cut lavender.
scenes.notes: floor here = cut down at 0.3 (still), the strips join the wave in petrol (not pure blue: the eye cannot focus it on the floor)

laser_parked.why: blue wave: a deep-sea curtain the whole width, kept under the 4° lantern line (the roof glazing starts there), 20 points a line

scenes.title: Ice mist
scenes.intent: The walls in low light blue and the cut in cold white breathe together; the beams barely cross; the plane dark; ice mist from the truss.

scenes.title: Slow eight
scenes.intent: Only the plane, in magenta, drawing one slow mirrored figure-eight every sixteen bars; lavender up into the haze.

scenes.title: Sea steel
scenes.intent: Outside, the road and the entrance spark; inside the rays glow deep sea and the walls stand in amber as a slow sweep; the cut steel.
scenes.notes: v2 id uv-steel: the UV went with the outside rule; the rays are deep sea now

scenes.title: Deep tent
scenes.intent: A tent: rays deep sea, the plane magenta, the walls amber, all swelling slowly; the beams meet in a wide fan over the floor; the truss lavender up.

laser_parked.why: deep tent: petrol arches on the flanks turning cube to cube

scenes.title: Green breath
scenes.intent: The hall breathes very slowly in green: the plane in green as a still fan, low; the floor petrol; only a deep-sea back light.

laser_parked.why: the net alone, 18 lines, breathing slowly

scenes.title: Cold rise
scenes.intent: The build back: a cold white comet climbs the walls toward the entrance over deep-sea rays; the walls light blue in a nod ripple; the plane open white.

scenes.title: Riser two
scenes.intent: The second riser: magenta walls, open-white plane, rose-copper rays and cut pulse on the beat; the beams circle fast, mirrored.

laser_parked.why: the second riser comb, 24 teeth

scenes.title: Second drop
scenes.intent: White-out: all eighteen beams open white in a fast mirrored figure-eight; the rays pump ice; the truss full cold white.

laser_parked.why: white-out: the wide still fans, hits on every beat

scenes.title: Ice strobe
scenes.intent: The whole hall strobes ice for 6 s: the hit of the second peak; the beams open white, a wide still fan.
scenes.notes: v2 id red-strobe: no strobe in a saturated colour (WCAG 2.2 2.3.1 red flash; Harding et al. 2005), so ice

scenes.title: The cathedral turns
scenes.intent: All the beams in open white circle in a ripple, the cathedral turning; the cut breathes steel blue; cold white rays.

laser_parked.why: the cathedral turns: white fans ripple cube to cube

scenes.title: Ice and fire
scenes.intent: Ice and fire: open-white walls, a red plane, ice rays; blocks flip across the hall; the beams trace a mirrored X.
scenes.notes: red accent: the ember plane holds (beams are not in the flip), the flipping rays are ice

scenes.title: Red fans
scenes.intent: Red fans: the walls in red as wide fans, the plane warm white, the rays ember in bars; the truss rose-copper up and ember down.
scenes.notes: red accent, lasers only: t4 as measured, red fans with pale violet round them (#9982d4)

laser_parked.why: red fans open on the bar, wide, mirrored

scenes.title: Last strobe
scenes.intent: The final hit: everything strobes for 8 s, open-white beams in a fast mirrored sweep, warm ash washes.

scenes.title: Afterglow
scenes.intent: Afterglow: rose-copper rays and a warm white plane breathe down; the walls in amber, a slow ripple of lean; a warm pool on the DJ.
scenes.notes: warmth after the peak without red or amber: rose-copper + 3200 K

laser_parked.why: afterglow: a rose-copper curtain breathes down, the whole width, under the lantern line

scenes.title: The last run
scenes.intent: The way out: steel blue runs up the walls toward the entrance, the walls in light blue sweep the same way; ice behind the DJ.

scenes.title: Embers out
scenes.intent: The last embers: outside the road and the entrance spark; inside only deep-ember rays and the plane in orange, low, a slow nod.
scenes.notes: red accent: deep ember at 0.4, sparkle 20 bpm (3 flashes/s max), over an ice floor

scenes.title: One beam (loop)
scenes.intent: Back to the start: the plane alone in low light blue, one slow lean; the loop begins again. The truss dark.

laser_parked.why: back to the start: the one searchlight of first light
